slides.headline: He left Chandigarh at 19 for a Canadian university. In 2026, he became Canada's Ambassador to the UAE.
Angad Singh Dhillon was named Canada's Ambassador to the United Arab Emirates on September 25, 2026
slides.body: Foreign Affairs Minister Anita Anand announced the appointment, with Dhillon succeeding Radha Krishna Panday as Canada's top diplomat in Abu Dhabi.

slides.headline: Born in Chandigarh, schooled in Mohali and Pune, he moved to Canada in 2010 to study international relations.
slides.body: He built his career inside Canada's federal government and the Prime Minister's Office - starting as a 2015 campaign organizer, rising to Chief of Staff for two cabinet ministers, then directing investment-file operations in the PMO.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when India-born professionals end up running another country's diplomacy in the Gulf.
slides.body: Dhillon's rise from a Punjab classroom to a Canadian ambassadorship is one more thread in a growing web of Indian-origin officials now shaping how the world's governments deal with each other.
